svg.title: Potbot U00 roadmap inventory
svg.desc: Plan 1.0 has 153 steps and Plan 1.1 has 204. Architecture 1.1 has 35 gates. Independent programme namespaces feed a source-hashed inventory with drift checks. Runtime and complete U00 qualification remain open.

g.text: Potbot U00 · preserve requirements before extending the runtime
Generated contract diagram · source coverage and runtime acceptance have separate evidence
Tool, memory, modernization, skills, UI and Syn
Repeated labels retain their source namespace
Source hashes + exact stage locators + U owners
Changed sources, lost stages or ambiguous identities fail the check
Next: per-requirement code/test review and supported-host evidence
U00 remains in progress · inventory does not qualify runtime capabilities
